name: vscode-pi-model-chat-provider
displayName: Pi Coding Agent - Language Model Provider
description: Fork of tintinweb's extension. Use a user-installed Pi CLI from VS Code chat via the native Language Model Provider API. Not published from this repository.

pi.binaryPath.description: Pi command or full path. On Windows, a bare name or an npm pi.cmd/pi.ps1 shim is resolved to node.exe plus Pi's cli.js and started without cmd.exe. PATH is the Extension Host PATH, which can differ from a PowerShell profile.

pi.workingDirectory.description: Working directory for Pi agent (default: workspace root)

pi.autoRestart.description: Automatically restart Pi agent on crash

pi.maxRestartAttempts.description: Maximum number of restart attempts before giving up

pi.additionalArgs.description: Extra arguments appended after --mode rpc. --mode, --session, --session-dir, --no-session, --resume, --continue, --fork, and -s are rejected so RPC mode and session storage stay under the settings below.

pi.debug.description: Enable debug logging for the Pi extension. Debug logs include RPC payloads and can contain prompts and tool output.

pi.commandTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Pi to accept one RPC command such as set_model or get_state. This does not limit how long a prompt may run.

pi.hungRequestTimeoutMs.description: Inactivity timeout for a running prompt, in milliseconds. 0 disables it. Any Pi protocol output resets the timer, so a long task that keeps streaming is not stopped. Open Pi dialogs also pause it.

pi.shutdownGraceMs.description: How long to wait for Pi to exit after cancellation, a hung prompt, or shutdown before the process is killed.

pi.persistSessions.markdownDescription: Off by default. Pi is started with `--no-session` and the transcript stays in memory. When on, session JSONL is written only under a folder inside the trusted workspace (see `pi.sessionDirectory`). Those files contain prompts, tool output, and file contents Pi reads. They are not encrypted.

pi.sessionDirectory.description: Directory for opt-in Pi session files. Empty uses <workspace>/.pi/vscode-lm-sessions. Paths outside the workspace are rejected. Ignored when pi.persistSessions is false.

pi.maxSessions.description: Soft cap on idle in-memory Pi processes. A busy process is not killed to make room.

pi.sessionIdleTimeout.description: Seconds before an idle in-memory Pi process is stopped. 0 leaves idle processes up until shutdown.
